name: Punta Cana
about: Hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: The Dominican Republic's all-inclusive resort coast — long white-sand beaches, warm water year-round, and whale-watching nearby in Samaná (humpbacks, Jan–Mar).
costOverview: Punta Cana runs expensive by Dominican standards — resort-zone taxis charge a real premium over the rest of the country, and even a beachfront dinner reaches genuine splurge territory fast.

specialSeasons.text: Humpback whales gather in Samaná Bay to breed and calve — a well-known day-trip whale-watching season.
Peak hurricane season, with real storm risk and the fewest visitors of the year.
